title: lastrea elwesii
intro: Lastrea elwesii, commonly known as Elwes' Lady Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lastrea elwesii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
